rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 Assigning Dice 1.1 Goal Cards 1.2 Pantry & Marketplace 1.3 Time Track 1.4 Savings 2 Upgrade & Refreshments 3 Baking 4 End Game Scoring Assigning Dice Goal Cards Place your die on the star(*) on the Main Game Board to draw 2 goal cards, keep 1. Pantry & Marketplace Place a die or dice on the desired ingredient. (see chart below) ● Gain ingredients equal to the current Pantry Card value. ● To buy additional ingredients, click on the die to pay coins equal to the die value for each additional ingredient. ● Pantry is limited to 6 per ingredient. ● Assign ingredients to recipes(permanent) prior to die placement and/or purchase to ensure adequate space. It’s important to remember that once you’ve marked an ingredient on a recipe, you can’t take it back — you wouldn’t take the egg out of the dough once you’ve mixed it in either! 😄 Ingredient Die Placement Info Flours Leavening Agents Sugar & Salt Vegetables & Herbs Fruits & Jams Milk & Dairy Oils & Fats Place a die matching one of the options displayed. Additional ingredients may be purchased based on the die value you used. You may not place a second die under the same ingredient. Eggs Place a die on the star(*). Must be less than 4 (1,2 or 3 only). Additional ingredients may be purchased based on the die value you used. Seeds & Spices Place a die on the star(*). Must be greater than 3 (4,5,6 only). Additional ingredients may be purchased based on the die value you used. Water Place a die of any value on the star(*). Additional ingredients may be purchased based on the die value you used. Chili & Hot Sauce Place a die on each star(*). The left die must be lower value than the right die. Dice cannot be equal. In order to collect ingredients, 2 dice must be placed during the same turn. Additional ingredients may be purchased based on the right/HIGHER die value you used. Chocolate & Cocoa Place a die on each star(*). The dice must be equal. In order to collect ingredients, 2 dice must be placed during the same turn. Additional ingredients may be purchased based on the die value you used. Time Track Place a die of any value on the leftmost available star(*). ● Gain the amount of time indicated. ● If multiple Dice are placed during the same turn, more time is rewarded. Savings Place a die of any value on the leftmost available star(*). ● Gain the amount of coins indicated. ● If multiple Dice are placed during the same turn, more coins are rewarded. Upgrade & Refreshments ● Refreshments (Blue) can only be used once. ● Upgrades (Brown) can be used once per round. ● You can hold a maximum of 3 upgrades, but can sell old ones back for half their cost. Baking ● Completed recipes earn Victory Points and are sold for the same number of Coins (lower right corner of card), ● Recipes not successfully baked by the end of the game (or the end of the 2nd round for recipes gained during the 1st round) are thrown in the trash and cost -5 Victory Points. ● If you can't, or don't want to, spend spend time to complete a recipe, roll a die for "Bake if You Dare!" ● 1-2: Recipe earns VP & Coins as normal. ● 3-4: Recipe earns VP, but no Coins. ● 5-6: Recipe fails, and is thrown in the trash (-5 VP) End Game Scoring ● VP from completed recipes. ● VP from successful goal cards. ● 2 VP per used upgrade (brown). ● 3 VP per unused upgrade (brown). ● 1 VP per refreshment (blue). ● 1 VP per 3 leftovers (coins + unused ingredients). ● -5 VP per recipe in the trash.

[Rating: 4/10] Recipe is roll dice, do what dice let you. Apply the random results to do stuff and get victory points.   I’m giving this game low score for the pantry cards - the 0/1’s are effectively “lose a turn” as you cannot get ingredients to fulfil recipes. “Lose a turn” is not a fun game mechanic, It’s stupid.   Some people will love this game. I’m a little over this genre.
